basic_info.description: Beyond its unassuming curb appeal, 430 Noriega unveils four levels of smart, sophisticated living with nearly a full panoramic viewspanning the Marin Headlands, Bay to Bridge, Golden Gate Park, and San Francisco's iconic landmarks. Originally built on 12th Avenue and relocated, this fully reimagined home offers five spacious bedrooms, multiple indoor-outdoor spaces, and a seamless blend of openness and privacy.    The main level is designed for effortless entertaining, featuring a chef's kitchen, open dining and living areas, and expansive terraces framing breathtaking views. The upper level offers three tranquil bedrooms, while the lower level provides two additional bedrooms, a spa-inspired sauna with shower, a full bath, powder room, and laundryperfect for multi-generational living or guest accommodations.    A private wine cellar and turntable parking system in the garage that add to the convenience, with a long driveway accommodating five+ off-street spaces. Fully detached and flooded with natural light, 430 Noriega is a rare findwhere every room is a front-row seat to San Francisco's most stunning vistas.
